evidence.reason: The workflow line is an explicit fail-closed trust guard: it refuses to continue when the measured SHA is not the verified default-branch tip. The current contract does not require staleness to be a green no-op, and the alleged driver behavior is not proof of a conflicting current requirement; an outer verification layer may intentionally be stricter than a fallback script. The finding is a preference to change error/status handling (and concedes it should be ignored if a red run is intended), not an implementation defect in existing intended behavior.
